verdict.rationale: Square's Subscriptions API and Invoices API let sellers configure recurring billing plans, which is a form of scheduled recurring workflow accessible via the platform's API/MCP surface, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose job/task scheduler or cron-like automation mechanism that an AI agent could use to schedule arbitrary recurring workflows beyond billing. missing for 10: a generic scheduling/automation API (cron, timers, recurring task triggers) independent of payments/subscriptions, evidence of MCP tools exposing scheduling controls, and any hands-on confirmation of recurring workflow automation working end-to-end.
